topics.topic_label: Automated AI research (the automate-the-research-loop thesis is now well-funded enough to pull Jeff Dean, Sanjay Ghemawat, Oriol Vinyals and Quoc Le out of a frontier lab at once into Discovery Loop, and HN's top comment turns the announcement into a departures-vs-arrivals ledger ending in NULL; Prime Intellect ships a self-improving RLM agent and a scientific skills library claiming 170,000 users lands on the board the same day)

Google model & agent cadence (Gemini 3.6 Flash and 3.5 Flash-Lite reach GA with 1M context, a March 2026 cutoff and ~17% fewer output tokens, and a third variant - Flash Cyber - is restricted to governments and trusted partners; but the day belongs to the leadership reset: Hassabis to Chair, Kavukcuoglu to SVP, and Dean, Ghemawat, Vinyals and Le out the door, with the thread tying it to the absence of a Gemini frontier GA release)

Automated AI research & science agents (PrimeIntellect ships prime-agent, a self-improving RLM agent for long-running autonomous tasks, as the #1 daily gainer on GitHub; Google DeepMind's WeatherNext posts a cyclone-forecasting breakthrough and Mistral's Leanstral 1.5 upgrades Lean 4 formal proof; From Trajectories to Evidence turns raw agent trajectories into auditable experimental records from a large industrial deployment)

Google frontier models (the lab that ships Gemini now has a product-and-platform operator at the helm — Kavukcuoglu reporting directly to Pichai with research pushed up to the Alphabet level — alongside a three-model release in Gemini 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite and 3.5 Flash Cyber, WeatherNext's cyclone-forecasting breakthrough, and a first-party google/skills pack on both the aggregate and Python boards)
